**Performance: PASS WITH NOTES** at `ff13b5ad6629cb63ceb3f5a8264c1442018b6cc7`.

Delta-only review from passed `b425d07`, output `282f375e12e622d4d6ef7b662b769b1d4834e54c`: `2a133c5a` plus the two main merges. The fix changes one queued-request filter; product directory/picture/claims code is unchanged between that fix and this final head. Both merges have documentation-only combined conflicts.

**Gate cost:** `community/directory.rs:485-498` reuses the already-computed `is_prime` and designation-based `live_holder`. It adds a constant boolean test for requests whose role matches, inside the existing iteration. No extra project/registry/store read, liveness lookup, allocation site, executable, timer or per-tick work.

The existing queued-heads query and per-role request traversal still happen; this is not a shortcut that removes those scans. For a live designated prime, the action-input vector is empty, saving its queued-instance enumeration and false recovery-command/JSON formatting. The waiting-request count remains visible and no request is consumed/closed. For a dead/missing designation the existing `project set` advice remains. Advice is text, not an executed project change or process launch.

Prior P177-N001 newly admitted delivery/writer costs and P177-N002 reference-vector/legacy-output costs remain. Inherited #175/#180/#182 build/load, digest and invalid-field scan qualifications remain; this delta does not reopen those reviews or add a lifecycle timer.

**Exact-head CI:** [42457966410](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42457966410), successful Rust job `128660930653`, exact upload artifact **13607684002**: **2,221 executed cases passed**, zero failures/errors, five separately skipped. Verified the live-designation-plus-queued-request / tombstoned-designation regression pair, recent legacy-row regression, no-project-docs delivery case and all six spawn guards. Rust lint, Node22/24 and delivers checks succeed. The author's ungated mutation result was not rerun locally.

Source and CI support the requested F002 gate repair; this cost verdict does not replace the new-head correctness/security verdicts. Clean worktree, matching frozen local/GitHub heads and CLEAN. No local build, test, mutation, live role/view call or performance probe.
